%md # NYC Taxi Demand Analysis **Business Question:** What are the demand patterns for NYC taxi services? **Data Source:** `samples.nyctaxi.trips` table. %md ## Trips by Hour of Day %python from pyspark.sql import functions as F df = spark.read.table("samples.nyctaxi.trips") # Extract hour hour_df = df.withColumn("hour", F.hour("tpep_pickup_datetime")) trips_by_hour = hour_df.groupBy("hour").count().orderBy("hour") display(trips_by_hour) %md ## Fare Behavior by Trip Distance Bucket %python # Define distance buckets bucket_df = df.withColumn( "dist_bucket", F.when(F.col("trip_distance") < 2, "<2") .when((F.col("trip_distance") >= 2) & (F.col("trip_distance") < 5), "2-5") .when((F.col("trip_distance") >= 5) & (F.col("trip_distance") < 10), "5-10") .otherwise(">=10") ) fare_by_bucket = bucket_df.groupBy("dist_bucket").agg( F.avg("fare_amount").alias("avg_fare"), F.count("fare_amount").alias("trip_cnt") ).orderBy("dist_bucket") display(fare_by_bucket) %md ## Top 10 Pickup ZIP Codes by Trip Count %python top_zips = df.groupBy("pickup_zip").count().orderBy(F.desc("count")).limit(10) display(top_zips) %md ## Findings %python # Compute required metrics for exit n_trips = df.count() peak_hour_row = trips_by_hour.orderBy(F.desc("count"), F.asc("hour")).first() peak_hour = peak_hour_row["hour"] if peak_hour_row else None # avg fare per mile for trips with distance > 0 filtered = df.filter(F.col("trip_distance") > 0) fare_per_mile = filtered.agg((F.sum("fare_amount")/F.sum("trip_distance")).alias("apm")).first()["apm"] avg_fare_per_mile = round(fare_per_mile, 2) if fare_per_mile is not None else None print(f"Total trips: {n_trips}") print(f"Peak hour: {peak_hour}") print(f"Avg fare per mile: {avg_fare_per_mile}") # Findings markdown displayHTML(f"""

Findings

  • Total trips recorded: {n_trips}
  • Peak pickup hour: {peak_hour}:00 with the highest number of trips.
  • Average fare per mile: ${avg_fare_per_mile}
""") # Exit JSON import json dbutils.notebook.exit(json.dumps({ "n_trips": n_trips, "peak_hour": peak_hour, "avg_fare_per_mile": avg_fare_per_mile }))

input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as n_trips FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips;
SELECT hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) as hr, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips GROUP BY hr ORDER BY cnt DESC, hr ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(fare_amount)/NULLIF(SUM(trip_distance),0),2) as avg_fare_per_mile FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips WHERE trip_distance > 0;
